lines.intro: Oh! A new face. The wind scattered our valley brochures all over the plaza… Could you find them for me? ({have}/{need})
lines.progress: You've found {have} of {need} brochures. The rest must be somewhere around the plaza.
lines.complete: All {need} brochures! Thank you, {name}. Visitors will finally know where to go. Here, take this blank map; I have one more favor to ask.

lines.intro: Our old valley map faded years ago. Could you draw a new one on that blank map? Your van's workbench should do nicely.
lines.progress: No rush. Use the workbench in your van to draw the valley map, then bring it here.
lines.complete: It's lovely! I'll pin it up right away. You know… people here would line up for a good cup of coffee. Take my old pour-over set. Your van could be a café!

lines.intro: One last thing: the lost-luggage room is a mess and travelers can't find their bags. Could you sort it out? The door's by the ticket gate.
lines.progress: The luggage room door is just left of the ticket gate. Pack everything neatly onto the shelves.
lines.complete: Every bag in its place! The station feels alive again, {name}. Here: the Valley Revival Board is yours to use. Let's wake up the rest of Hakuba together.

station.after: The whole station is buzzing! Check the Valley Revival Board when you're ready to open the roads.

lines.intro: Oh, hey. You're the van person Mrs. Kobayashi told me about? Nobody camps here anymore. The demo tent blew down in the last storm. Could you pitch it? Balance the guy lines, or it'll lean right over.
lines.progress: The tent's on the meadow, left of the shop. Peg the four guy lines so the pulls cancel out.
lines.complete: Look at that, standing straight! You've got a feel for tension, {name}. Campers will see it from the road.

lines.intro: My old work van is rusting behind the shop, and its parts are scattered all over the yard. Dig out {need} good ones (1 stamina each) and we'll build something for your van. ({have}/{need})
lines.progress: {have} of {need} parts so far. Look for the glinting piles around the yard.
lines.complete: Hinges, a lamp, brackets, a good panel. That's enough for a real build. And here's something for your trouble.

lines.intro: Time to decide what your van really is. Choose your trade at my workbench, the one by the garage door, and we'll build its first module together.
lines.progress: The workbench is by the garage door. Pick your trade and cut the parts to the blueprint.
lines.complete: Clean cuts, solid joints. That's a real business on wheels now, {name}. The garage is yours whenever you need it: snow tires, a roof rack, whatever the road asks for.

snowpeak.after: The campsite's busy again! Use the garage when your van needs an upgrade.

lines.intro: The shuttle map is chaos! Every route crosses another, and visitors miss their connections. Could you redraw the routes at the board by the bus bays?
lines.progress: The route board is next to the bus bays. Connect each pair of matching stops, and no crossings!
lines.complete: Every bus has a clean line! Nobody will miss the gondola now. Thank you, {name}.

lines.intro: Travelers keep dropping their IC cards around the terminal. Could you find {need} and bring them to the lost and found? ({have}/{need})
lines.progress: {have} of {need} cards found. Check under the benches and by the bus bays.
lines.complete: All {need}! Their owners will be so relieved. Here's a little thank-you from the bus company.

lines.intro: Last thing: our timetable is impossible to read. Could you make a new one at the board? Match each departure time to its route.
lines.progress: The timetable board is by the bus bays. Put each departure time next to the right route.
lines.complete: Now *that's* a timetable people will read! The Valley Shuttle runs again, {name}. Every restored region will get more visitors.

happo_terminal.after: Buses every twenty minutes! Use the Revival Board here to open roads north and west.

lines.intro: Half the street is dark, and our izakaya feels lonely. We need a signature dish to bring people in. Could you help grill a yakitori set at our grill?
lines.progress: The grill's out front. Turn the skewers when they're perfectly browned!
lines.complete: Smoky, glossy, perfect. That smell alone will bring people down the street!

lines.intro: It worked: we're full tonight! But every regular has an opinion about where they sit. Could you seat everyone at the counter?
lines.progress: Everyone's waiting by the door. Seat them so every wish is kept.
lines.complete: Everyone's happy and the counter is buzzing. You've got a knack for people, {name}.

lines.intro: Let's light up the whole street! Our old paper lanterns blew all over Echoland. Find {need} and we'll string them up. ({have}/{need})
lines.progress: {have} of {need} lanterns. They're tumbling around the street!
lines.complete: Look at the street glow! The Evening Market is back, {name}. People will stay out late again.

echoland.after: Echoland glows every night now. Come by for a skewer after your shift!

lines.intro: Hikers turn back before the pond because the hut's half-empty. Supply bundles came up on the gondola, but they're scattered along the trail. Could you carry {need} to the hut? Each one is 1 stamina. ({have}/{need})
lines.progress: {have} of {need} bundles. They're the canvas sacks along the ridge trail.
lines.complete: Full shelves! Hikers can rest and refuel here again. Thank you, {name}.

lines.intro: The trail cairns collapsed in the storm, and people get lost in the fog. Rebuild the big one so its top stone points down the trail toward the pond.
lines.progress: The fallen cairn is by the trail sign. Stack the stones so they stand, and so the top one leans over the marker.
lines.complete: It stands and it points! Hikers will find the pond even in the fog.

lines.intro: One last idea: a dawn breakfast at the pond, with the Sanzan peaks mirrored in the water. Could you cook a sunrise set on the hut stove?
lines.progress: The hut stove is ready. Time each step right for a perfect breakfast.
lines.complete: The peaks in the pond, a warm breakfast, the sun coming up. People will hike up for this, {name}.

happo_pond.after: The pond trail is busy every morning now. Green season hikers love it here.

lines.intro: The gondola's running again, but a cabin has to be balanced or it sways! Can you seat this group so both benches weigh the same and everyone's happy?
lines.progress: The cabin's waiting at the platform. Balance the benches!
lines.complete: Smooth as anything. Up they go! Thanks, {name}.

lines.intro: The summit terrace has no seats. People ride up, look around and ride straight back down. Could you build a bench at the workbench up here?
lines.progress: The workbench is by the terrace rail. Cut the bench parts to the blueprint.
lines.complete: A bench with *that* view! People will stay up here for hours.

lines.intro: Last thing: the terrace slopes used to be full of wildflowers. Seed packets from the old planting days are scattered around. Find {need}? ({have}/{need})
lines.progress: {have} of {need} packets. Look around the terrace edge.
lines.complete: Come green season this slope will be a sea of flowers. The Sky Terrace is open, {name}!

iwatake.after: In green season the terrace is the best seat in Hakuba.

lines.intro: The alpine garden is so overgrown you can't see the flowers! Could you weed it and rescue {need} plants for replanting? It's hard work: 1 stamina each. ({have}/{need})
lines.progress: {have} of {need} plants rescued. They're in the weedy patches around the garden.
lines.complete: Look at them, safe and sound! The garden can breathe again.

lines.intro: Now we replant. Every bed has to fit the plot exactly, with no bare soil. Could you lay them out at the potting table?
lines.progress: The potting table is by the greenhouse. Fit every bed into the plot with no gaps.
lines.complete: Perfect rows! It'll bloom like a painting this summer.

lines.intro: Last thing: the farms nearby have no buyers. Could you arrange a farm-stand crate? Here's how the farmers like it laid out.
lines.progress: Arrange the crate at the potting table. Follow the farmers' notes.
lines.complete: The farm stand is open! Soba flour, apples, nozawana, rice. Everything local. Thank you, {name}!

goryu.after: The alpine garden is in full bloom. Green-season visitors love it.

lines.intro: We want an MTB park here, but the trails washed out! Could you lay out new lines on the trail map? Each trail needs its own track.
lines.progress: The trail map is by the lift. Connect each trailhead to its finish, with no crossings.
lines.complete: Those lines flow! Riders are going to love this.

lines.intro: The trail markers blew all over the base area. Find {need} so riders know where to go. ({have}/{need})
lines.progress: {have} of {need} markers. Check around the base area.
lines.complete: Every trail's marked. Safe and easy to follow!

lines.intro: Last job: the demo bikes need a tune before opening day. Time each step at the workstand: lube, brakes, tires.
lines.progress: The workstand is out front. Time each step right!
lines.complete: Smooth shifting, sharp brakes. The MTB park is open, {name}!

hakuba47.after: Bikes in green season, powder in winter. Hakuba 47 never sleeps.

lines.intro: I'm writing a new field guide for the wetlands, but my knees won't let me gather samples. Could you find {need} marsh plants? ({have}/{need})
lines.progress: {have} of {need} plants. They grow along the wetland edge.
lines.complete: Skunk cabbage, cotton grass, iris… every one! The guide is nearly done.

lines.intro: The boardwalk is broken in places, and visitors stomp straight through the marsh. Could you plan new paths between the viewpoints?
lines.progress: The boardwalk plan is by the visitor center. Join each viewpoint pair without crossing.
lines.complete: Now people can walk the whole wetland without hurting a single plant.

lines.intro: One last thing: a tour pack for visitors. Could you pack it the way I like? My notes are here.
lines.progress: Pack it at the visitor center table, following my notes.
lines.complete: Just the way I'd pack it. The nature park is open again, dear. Thank you, {name}.

tsugaike.after: The wetlands are full of quiet walkers. Chiyo's guide sells out every week.

lines.intro: The water here is the clearest in Japan, and nobody knows! Could you take the photo that changes that? Frame it right: peaks, a paddleboard, no trash.
lines.progress: Use the camera on the jetty. Follow the framing notes.
lines.complete: That's the one. People are going to see this and come.

lines.intro: Let's make postcards from it! Could you letter the set at the workbench? Steady hands.
lines.progress: The workbench is by the boathouse. Trace the lettering.
lines.complete: Beautiful. They're going on every counter in the valley.

lines.intro: Before visitors come, let's make the beach spotless. Could you pick up {need} bits of litter? ({have}/{need})
lines.progress: {have} of {need}. Look along the shore.
lines.complete: Spotless! SUP, kayaks, swimming: Lake Aoki is open, {name}. The whole valley is awake.

aokiko.after: Lake Aoki is the green-season jewel of the valley.
